title: Accelerating Distributed Digital Ising Machines
abstract: arXiv:2611.23883v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Ising machines, dedicated accelerators built around the dynamics of Ising-like spin models, have emerged as a leading platform for combinatorial optimization and probabilistic sampling. The problems that motivate them require millions of spins, far beyond the on-chip capacity of any single device, so a practical Ising machine must distribute its computation across many devices. Prior work reports throughput at a single operating point, leaving the binding resource unidentified and platform crossovers measurable only by experiment; no calibrated cross-platform cost model of distributed Ising machines has been reported, nor have systematic techniques to accelerate their Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) workloads. translated_title: 加速分布式数字伊辛机
translated_abstract: 伊辛机是围绕伊辛类自旋模型动力学构建的专用加速器，已成为组合优化和概率采样领域的主流平台。然而，这类问题所需的自旋数量达数百万个，远超任何单个器件的片上容量，因此实用的伊辛机必须将计算分布到多个器件上。先前的工作仅在单一运行点报告吞吐量，无法识别瓶颈资源，平台之间的性能交叉点也只能通过实验测量；目前尚无经过校准的分布式伊辛机跨平台成本模型，也缺乏加速其马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）工作负载的系统性技术。本工作提出了一个经过校准的成本模型，将数字伊辛机的扫描时间分解为计算、内存、同步和器件间通信等组成部分，并在三代GPU及FPGA架构上以平均4.8%的误差完成了验证。
tldr: 该论文提出了首个经过校准的分布式数字伊辛机跨平台成本模型，将扫描时间分解为计算、内存、同步和器件间通信四项，并据此提供系统性技术来加速其MCMC工作负载。
en_tdlr: This work presents the first calibrated cross-platform cost model for distributed digital Ising machines, decomposing sweep time into compute, memory, synchronization, and inter-device communication terms, along with systematic techniques to accelerate their MCMC workloads.
